chunks: The day He will gather them together it will appear to them that they had lived (in the world) but an hour of a day to make each other's acquaintance. Verily those who deny the meeting with God will be lost, and not find the way.

key_terms.يَتَعَارَفُونَ: They will make each other's acquaintance

ai.seo_question: How long will worldly life seem on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yunus (10:45) underscores the relativity of time in the Hereafter, contrasting the brevity of worldly existence with the eternal reality of divine accountability. It serves as a warning to those who rejected the resurrection, emphasizing that their denial led to spiritual loss and a lack of true guidance.
